text.p: Luxembourg on Monday joined in the condemnation of what it called the "cowardly" murder of a Spanish politician by the Basque separatist group ETA.
"Luxembourg is horrified at the assassination of Miguel Angel Blanco," the Foreign Ministry said in a statement.

"This barbaric act committed in cold blood against a defenceless hostage reminds Luxembourgers of other acts committed against innocent civilians during the darkest times of (their) history," it added, referring to Luxembourg's occupation by Nazi Germany in World War Two.
Blanco, 29, a Basque town councillor of the ruling Popular Party, died on Sunday from two gunshot wounds to the head.

ETA, which has killed nearly 800 people since 1968 when it started a drive for a separate state, kidnapped Blanco on Thursday and threatened to kill him by 4 p.m. on Saturday unless ETA inmates in jails across Spain were transferred to the Basque region.
